Grit excellence tak bridge hai.
Himmat ek dhimi aawaz hai.
Jeet tak persist karo.
Brave shayad long live na karein, cautious waise bhi survive nahi karte.
Bahadur jhelte hain.
Himmat ek kadam se shuru hoti hai.
Grit lamba hai.
Khamoshi behtar sunne ka pul hai.
Khamoshi wahi hai jahan strength accumulate hoti.
Courage—familiar ko chhodne ki power.
Jo kabhi mistake nahi karta—wo kuch naya try hi nahi karta.
Dhairya kadwa hota hai, lekin iska phal meetha hota hai.
Hard dinon pe aa jana—grit.
Khamoshi sachai ko saaf karti hai.
Jab sab haar maan lein, tabhi asli grit dikhta hai.
Khamoshi ko suno.
Khamoshi disguise mein taqat hai.
Grit lambi raah se bach kar nikalta.
Courage—vulnerable hone ki willingness se shuru.
Khali bartan sabse zyada shor karte hain.
Himmat ek manspeshi hai.
